sloka: तेषाम् चैव स्वस्त्ययनम् महर्षिः स चकार ह ।प्रस्थिताम्श्चैव तान् प्रेक्ष्यपिता पुत्रानिवान्वगात् ॥२-५५-२॥
transliteration: teṣām caiva svastyayanam maharṣiḥ sa cakāra ha ।prasthitāmścaiva tān prekṣyapitā putrānivānvagāt ॥2-55-2॥

translations.english: Seeing them setting forth, the great sage blessed them for a safe journey and followed them like a father following his children.
